question: 计算机学院2023届毕业生的平均起薪是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.monthly_salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM offer o JOIN student s ON o.student_id = s.id JOIN major m ON s.major_id = m.id JOIN college c ON m.college_id = c.id WHERE c.name = '计算机学院' AND s.graduation_year = 2023 AND o.sign_status = '已签约'
note: 「起薪」统一口径为已签约 offer 的月薪均值

question: 各专业就业率排名，只看毕业生人数超过50人的专业
gold_sql: SELECT m.name AS major_name, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.sign_status = '已签约' THEN s.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 2) AS employment_rate FROM major m JOIN student s ON s.major_id = m.id LEFT JOIN offer o ON o.student_id = s.id GROUP BY m.id, m.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) > 50 ORDER BY employment_rate DESC
note: 只返回问题问的两列。毕业生数仅用于 HAVING 过滤，不返回

question: 2025年西安地区招收软件工程专业毕业生的岗位数量最多的前5家企业是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS company_name, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM job_posting j JOIN company c ON j.company_id = c.id JOIN major m ON j.required_major_id = m.id WHERE j.city = '西安' AND m.name = '软件工程' AND j.publish_date >= '2025-01-01' AND j.publish_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY job_count DESC LIMIT 5
note: 「最多」明确为岗位条数，避免和招聘人数混淆

question: 投递超过20次但一个offer都没拿到的学生有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM (SELECT a.student_id FROM job_application a GROUP BY a.student_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 20) t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM offer o WHERE o.student_id = t.student_id)
note: 子查询 + NOT EXISTS，容易误写成 NOT IN 遇到 NULL 的坑

question: 统计每门课程的平均分和修过该课学生的平均起薪，只看选课人数不少于30人的课程，按平均起薪从高到低排
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS course_name, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avg_score, ROUND(AVG(o.monthly_salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM course c JOIN course_enrollment e ON e.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN offer o ON o.student_id = e.student_id AND o.sign_status = '已签约' WHERE e.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) >= 30 ORDER BY avg_salary DESC
note: avg_score 覆盖全部有成绩的选课记录，avg_salary 只算已签约 offer。原版用 INNER JOIN 会把 avg_score 也算在有 offer 的子集上，是错的

question: 2022到2024年计算机学院的就业率变化趋势
gold_sql: SELECT es.stat_month, ROUND(100.0 * es.employed_count / es.graduated_count, 2) AS employment_rate FROM employment_stat es JOIN college c ON es.college_id = c.id WHERE c.name = '计算机学院' AND es.major_id IS NULL AND es.stat_month >= '2022-01' AND es.stat_month <= '2024-12' ORDER BY es.stat_month
note: 必须过滤 major_id IS NULL，否则学院级汇总和专业级明细重复计数

question: 签约字节跳动的学生平均GPA是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.gpa), 3) AS avg_gpa FROM offer o JOIN student s ON o.student_id = s.id JOIN company c ON o.company_id = c.id WHERE c.name = '字节跳动' AND o.sign_status = '已签约'
note: 只返回 GPA。之前 gold 多带一个 student_count，导致模型答对也判错——这是测试集设计缺陷

question: 每个学院平均起薪最高的专业是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT college_name, major_name, avg_salary FROM (SELECT c.name AS college_name, m.name AS major_name, ROUND(AVG(o.monthly_salary), 2) AS avg_salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY AVG(o.monthly_salary) DESC) AS rn FROM offer o JOIN student s ON o.student_id = s.id JOIN major m ON s.major_id = m.id JOIN college c ON m.college_id = c.id WHERE o.sign_status = '已签约' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, m.id, m.name) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY avg_salary DESC
note: 窗口函数分组取 Top1，整套题的分水岭

question: 必修课和选修课的平均分分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_type, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM course_enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.course_type ORDER BY avg_score DESC
note: 必须过滤 score IS NULL，否则 AVG 会忽略但 COUNT 会虚高

question: 生源地为陕西的学生，毕业后留在陕西就业的比例是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN co.city = '西安' THEN s.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 2) AS stay_rate FROM student s LEFT JOIN offer o ON o.student_id = s.id AND o.sign_status = '已签约' LEFT JOIN company co ON o.company_id = co.id WHERE s.hometown_province = '陕西'
note: 「留陕」= 签约企业总部在陕西（数据里只有西安）。分母用 LEFT JOIN 保证没就业的也计入

question: 一共有多少名学生？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM student

question: 男生和女生各有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM student GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender

question: 各行业分别有多少家企业？
gold_sql: SELECT industry, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM company GROUP BY industry ORDER BY company_count DESC

question: 上市企业占全部企业的比例是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_listed) / COUNT(*), 2) AS listed_ratio FROM company
note: 比例计算，注意乘 100.0 避免整数除法

question: 各类型的岗位分别有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT job_type, COUNT(*) AS posting_count FROM job_posting GROUP BY job_type ORDER BY posting_count DESC

question: 各投递状态的记录数分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM job_application GROUP BY status ORDER BY cnt DESC

question: 学分最高的课程是哪一门？
gold_sql: SELECT name, credit FROM course ORDER BY credit DESC LIMIT 1

question: 平均每个岗位招聘多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(headcount), 2) AS avg_headcount FROM job_posting
note: 原题「招聘人数最多的岗位」有歧义：可按单个岗位取最大值，也可按岗位名称汇总。改成平均值，口径唯一

question: 成绩低于60分的选课记录有多少条？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM course_enrollment WHERE score < 60

question: 不限专业的岗位有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM job_posting WHERE required_major_id IS NULL

question: 各生源省份的学生人数，取前5名
gold_sql: SELECT hometown_province, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM student GROUP BY hometown_province ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

question: 各学期的选课记录数分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT term, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM course_enrollment GROUP BY term ORDER BY term

question: 重修学生的平均分是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS avg_score FROM course_enrollment WHERE is_retake = 1 AND score IS NOT NULL
note: 条件 + 聚合，注意 NULL

question: 各学院分别有多少个专业？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, COUNT(m.id) AS major_count FROM college c LEFT JOIN major m ON m.college_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY major_count DESC
note: LEFT JOIN 保证没有专业的学院也出现

question: 各学院分别有多少名学生？

question: 各专业的平均绩点是多少？按绩点从高到低排
gold_sql: SELECT m.name AS major_name, ROUND(AVG(s.gpa), 2) AS avg_gpa FROM major m JOIN student s ON s.major_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY avg_gpa DESC

question: 各学院的平均绩点是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, ROUND(AVG(s.gpa), 2) AS avg_gpa FROM college c JOIN major m ON m.college_id = c.id JOIN student s ON s.major_id = m.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY avg_gpa DESC

question: 各行业的平均起薪是多少？只看已签约的offer
gold_sql: SELECT co.industry, ROUND(AVG(o.monthly_salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM offer o JOIN company co ON o.company_id = co.id WHERE o.sign_status = '已签约' GROUP BY co.industry ORDER BY avg_salary DESC

question: 各城市的岗位数量分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS posting_count FROM job_posting GROUP BY city ORDER BY posting_count DESC

question: 各城市分别有多少家企业？
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM company GROUP BY city ORDER BY company_count DESC

question: 发放offer数量最多的企业是哪家？发了多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT co.name AS company_name, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM offer o JOIN company co ON o.company_id = co.id GROUP BY co.id, co.name ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: 各学院分别开设了多少门课程？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, COUNT(co.id) AS course_count FROM college c LEFT JOIN course co ON co.college_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY course_count DESC

question: 必修课和选修课的平均分分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_type, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM course c JOIN course_enrollment e ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE e.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.course_type ORDER BY avg_score DESC
note: JOIN + 分组 + NULL 过滤

question: 各专业分别有多少学生拿到过offer？
gold_sql: SELECT m.name AS major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.student_id) AS offer_students FROM major m JOIN student s ON s.major_id = m.id JOIN offer o ON o.student_id = s.id GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY offer_students DESC
note: COUNT DISTINCT 避免一个学生多个 offer 重复计数

question: 各学院的已签约人数分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS signed_count FROM college c JOIN major m ON m.college_id = c.id JOIN student s ON s.major_id = m.id JOIN offer o ON o.student_id = s.id AND o.sign_status = '已签约' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY signed_count DESC

question: 2024届各专业分别有多少名毕业生？
gold_sql: SELECT m.name AS major_name, COUNT(*) AS graduate_count FROM student s JOIN major m ON s.major_id = m.id WHERE s.graduation_year = 2024 GROUP BY m.id, m.name ORDER BY graduate_count DESC

question: 内推渠道有多少人被录用？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS hired_count FROM job_application WHERE channel = '内推' AND status = '已录用'
note: 「多少人」按人去重：72 条录用记录来自 63 个学生

question: 各企业规模的岗位数量分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT co.scale, COUNT(*) AS posting_count FROM job_posting j JOIN company co ON j.company_id = co.id GROUP BY co.scale ORDER BY posting_count DESC

question: 男女学生的平均起薪分别是多少？只看已签约
gold_sql: SELECT s.gender, ROUND(AVG(o.monthly_salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM offer o JOIN student s ON o.student_id = s.id WHERE o.sign_status = '已签约' GROUP BY s.gender ORDER BY avg_salary DESC

question: 各城市岗位薪资区间中位值的平均数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT city, ROUND(AVG((salary_min + salary_max) / 2.0), 2) AS avg_salary FROM job_posting GROUP BY city ORDER BY avg_salary DESC

question: 选课人数超过50人的课程，各有多少人选、平均分多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS course_name, COUNT(*) AS enroll_count, ROUND(AVG(e.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM course c JOIN course_enrollment e ON e.course_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY enroll_count DESC

question: 每个学院在2024年6月的就业率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, ROUND(100.0 * es.employed_count / es.graduated_count, 2) AS employment_rate FROM employment_stat es JOIN college c ON es.college_id = c.id WHERE es.stat_month = '2024-06' AND es.major_id IS NULL ORDER BY employment_rate DESC
note: 必须过滤 major_id IS NULL 取学院级

question: 有多少名学生一次都没投递过简历？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM student s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job_application a WHERE a.student_id = s.id)

question: 拿到offer但还没签约的学生有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt FROM offer WHERE sign_status = '未签约'

question: 薪资高于全部岗位平均薪资的岗位有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM job_posting WHERE (salary_min + salary_max) / 2.0 > (SELECT AVG((salary_min + salary_max) / 2.0) FROM job_posting)

question: 每个学院学生人数最多的专业是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT college_name, major_name, student_count FROM (SELECT c.name AS college_name, m.name AS major_name, COUNT(s.id) AS student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(s.id) DESC) AS rn FROM college c JOIN major m ON m.college_id = c.id JOIN student s ON s.major_id = m.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, m.id, m.name) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY student_count DESC

question: 各投递渠道的录用率分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已录用' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS hire_rate FROM job_application GROUP BY channel ORDER BY hire_rate DESC
note: 原题问「哪个最高」，模型返回全部渠道也合理，改成问全部渠道

question: 每个城市薪资最高的岗位是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT city, title, avg_salary FROM (SELECT city, title, (salary_min + salary_max) / 2.0 AS avg_salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY (salary_min + salary_max) / 2.0 DESC) AS rn FROM job_posting) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY avg_salary DESC

question: 各行业已签约offer的平均月薪，只看签约数超过10的行业
gold_sql: SELECT co.industry, ROUND(AVG(o.monthly_salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM offer o JOIN company co ON o.company_id = co.id WHERE o.sign_status = '已签约' GROUP BY co.industry HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY avg_salary DESC
note: 去掉 signed_count 诊断列——问题只问平均月薪

question: 各专业学生人数占本学院的比例是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS college_name, m.name AS major_name, COUNT(s.id) AS student_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(s.id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s2 JOIN major m2 ON s2.major_id = m2.id WHERE m2.college_id = c.id), 2) AS ratio FROM college c JOIN major m ON m.college_id = c.id JOIN student s ON s.major_id = m.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, m.id, m.name ORDER BY college_name, student_count DESC
